findings.claim: The supplied continuous contrast functions are observed-node linear fits over the complete observed window [0.0,0.5]; no polynomial fit was accepted for the landmark_00 features read, and extrapolation is disallowed, so these curves are descriptive within-support contrasts rather than absolute reward targets.

The landmark_00 local coordinate contrasts are non-monotone: each read feature shows multiple sign changes (4-10) with strong sign conflicts (1-9) and large first-vs-last rate z-scores of opposite sign, so a constant rule is not supported and a time-conditioned rule is the better description of the observed support.

Whole-window z-scores for the read landmark_00 features are small in magnitude (|z| < 0.65) and mixed in sign, so the net whole-window coordinate contrast is weak even where local rates are large; local rate evidence should not be presented as a whole-window effect.

The declared objective is final predicted target affinity primary with validity and strain secondary under coordinate-only control, and the observed label semantics are recorded affinities removed with an equal score prior, so no observed affinity benefit can be claimed from these coordinate contrasts.

hypotheses.direction: time-conditioned regional attention on landmark_00 local coordinates
hypotheses.falsifier: a constant regional weight matches or exceeds the time-conditioned rule in observed-node fit fidelity across the window
hypotheses.observable: observed-node contrast value at landmark_00 local coordinate features over [0.0,0.5]
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned regional attention recipe that follows the observed-node contrast sign changes at landmark_00 local coordinates will track the observed contrast better than a constant regional weight over the observed window.

hypotheses.falsifier: conditioning on the local landmark contrast degrades whole-window contrast or regional diagnostics relative to the incumbent static regional weight
hypotheses.observable: whole-window z of landmark_00 features and regional effect diagnostics
hypotheses.statement: Retaining freedom for the surrounding coordinates of the landmark_00 region while conditioning attention on the local landmark contrast will preserve the weak whole-window net contrast without forcing an unsupported absolute geometric target.

limitations: Only the first six continuous_trends rows (landmark_00 features) were read; the remaining 194 curve features and the branch_adjusted, endpoint_effects, increment_effects, joint_diagnostics, regional_effects, survival_effects and turnover_accounting tables were not inspected in this turn.
No decoded terminal labels or current-study outcome data are supplied, so last-record or survival credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.
The read contrasts are coordinate features in predicted endpoint world A; they are not physical interaction energies and do not establish neural-module causation.
No uncertainty/multiplicity-adjusted ranking across coordinate hypotheses was performed because the relevant adjusted-support tables were not read.
